scope: Bounded primary-source audit for continuous-startup measured validation; not an exhaustive absence-of-data claim

coverage.productionThermalEquations: Measured pre-trip subsystem comparison with declared forcing and generic plant assumptions
coverage.coldHeatup: Measured contextual examples identified; executable independent-forcing case not established
coverage.powerAscensionKinetics: Numerical verification only; no measured power holdout with complete independent forcing established

cases.decision: Use for narrow measured thermal comparison of shared production equations

locations: Table 2: printed page 13 / PDF page 25, measured initial conditions
Figures 22-26, 29-34 and 37-40: measured magenta paths in panel (a); blue calculated paths excluded

missing: Applicable plant geometry and effective thermal-storage inventories
Numeric pressurizer heater and spray histories
Charging/letdown meter reference conditions and incoming enthalpy
Sensor transfer functions and complete measurement uncertainty
cases.qualification: Existing measured curves are already inspected, not a blind holdout. Keep original extraction and uncertainty qualifications. End before operator reopening and trip; do not treat post-trip neutron indication as total decay heat.

cases.decision: Candidate thermal/hydraulic commissioning case; reject as a measured transient-power holdout

cases.boundaryQualification: Published benchmark boundary tables are not automatically raw measured actuator records. An imposed pressure cannot also be scored as a held-out prediction.
missingForMeasuredKineticsReplay: Measured reactor-power transient holdout; report explicitly states none is available
Independent core feedback temperature histories or a sufficiently specified predictive spatial thermal model
Verified complete input package with redistribution conditions
cases.qualification: Hot commissioning pump-start event, not continuous cold-to-grid startup. Asymmetric loop readings are sensor-filtered; they cannot be substituted for instantaneous core-average feedback without additional assumptions.

cases.decision: Measured startup context; insufficiently specified for an independent-forcing validation replay

Figure 2-1 and Table 2-2, printed page 2-3 / PDF page 19: Westinghouse heatup
Figure 2-9, printed page 2-12 / PDF page 28: low-power loading
Figure 3-1, printed page 3-3 / PDF page 41: C-E heatup

measuredContext: low-power loading temperature changes and power
missing: Identified plant and event for each example
Evidence that examples belong to one continuous startup
Synchronized rod, boron, pump, valve and heater histories
Applicable plant inventories and heat-transfer parameters
Raw sampling times, instrument response and uncertainty budget
Turbine speed, generator phase/voltage and breaker records
cases.qualification: Typical graphical examples from actual records; no raw dataset extracted or bundled. Figure reading would not establish an acquisition frequency. Do not infer missing controls from the response curves and call the resulting replay validation.

publicationPolicy: Public access is not an open-source data license. Link primary publications; do not bundle or relicense their PDF prose or artwork. The audit itself is original repository documentation.
acceptancePolicy: Numerical checks and completed comparisons cannot promote the physical status to passed. Require declared independent forcing, applicable plant parameters, held-out measurements, sensor interpretation and an uncertainty-based acceptance protocol.
